answer: Sybil resistance: treat identity creation as a narrow inlet—cheap to enter once, expensive to flood. Full emission sits at a summit unlocked only after non-transferable graded work accrues across epochs. Each new correlated account widens a risk delta that multiplies bond cost and resets the summit climb, so an attacker pays rising capital per clone while never inheriting prior work credit. Mass fakes stay stuck at the inlet, cash-negative before they can harvest rewards.
